written: 2026-11-15, before any hybrid run on any dataset
development_sets: fiqa-train (1000-query seeded sample of the 5500 train queries)
memory-selection (100 of the 400 held-out LongMemEval questions, seed 20261114)
metric: nDCG@10 macro-averaged over the three development sets; recall@100 recorded

candidates.blend_minmax: weights (1 - a, a) on min-max normalised lexical and cosine scores of each list's top L, a in 0.1..0.9, L in 100, 300, 1000 (the engine's current default is a = 0.5, L = 100)
candidates.convex_tm2: weights (1 - a, a) on scores divided by the list maximum (Bruch et al. TM2 with theoretical minimum 0 for BM25 and for the cosine floor the engine applies), same a and L

adopt_rule: A candidate replaces the engine default only if its macro nDCG@10 exceeds the current default's by at least 0.003 and no development set falls by more than 0.005 below the current default. Among eligible candidates the highest macro nDCG@10 wins; otherwise the default stays.
comparators: each comparator's RRF constant is the one maximising macro nDCG@10 of its own lexical and vector top-100 lists on the same sets, over 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 30, 40, 60, 100, 200; ties go to 60
freeze: hybrid_fusion.py writes fusion_frozen.json once; it is committed before hybrid_run.py eval runs. Evaluation sets are read once.
